claims.text: The Sonnenalp Hotel is located in the heart of Vail Village.

findings.quote: Sonnenalp is located in the heart of Vail Village, one of Colorado's most iconic mountain destinations.

claims.text: Every suite and hotel room has a view of either Gore Creek or Vail Village.

findings.quote: The Sonnenalp features 112 luxury suites and 15 hotel rooms – all with a view of either Gore Creek or Vail Village.

claims.text: Each suite has a bedroom and a living room area.

findings.quote: Each suite has a bedroom and a well-appointed, delightfully comfortable living room area.

claims.text: Many suites feature gas fireplaces, balconies and heated marble bathroom floors.

findings.quote: Many suites feature separate living areas, gas fireplaces, balconies, heated marble bathroom floors, and views of Gore Creek or Vail Village.

claims.text: Swiss Chalet serves Swiss cuisine including fondue, raclette and schnitzel.

findings.quote: Swiss Chalet at Sonnenalp offers authentic Swiss cuisine including fondue, raclette, schnitzel, and alpine specialties

claims.text: Swiss Chalet reflects Sonnenalp's Bavarian heritage.

findings.quote: The restaurant reflects Sonnenalp's Bavarian heritage

claims.text: King's Club serves cocktails with live entertainment beside a roaring fireplace.

findings.quote: Savor exquisite cocktails accompanied by live entertainment, all set against the backdrop of a roaring fireplace.

claims.text: Bully Ranch offers indoor and outdoor dining with Colorado-inspired dishes, burgers and salads.

findings.quote: Bully Ranch offers indoor and outdoor dining along with a menu featuring Colorado-inspired dishes, burgers, salads, and signature specialties.

claims.text: The spa's indoor and outdoor whirlpools look out over Gore Creek.

findings.quote: Indoor and outdoor co-ed whirlpools offering the best views of the Gore creek.

claims.text: The spa has a cafe and an oxygen bar.

findings.quote: Spa Cafe & Oxygen Bar

claims.text: The Sonnenalp Kids Club offers arts and crafts sessions and outdoor excursions.

findings.quote: From engaging arts and crafts sessions to exhilarating outdoor excursions, children are immersed in experiences that are both educational and fun.

claims.text: Through Gorsuch, the ski concierge provides ski, snowboard and helmet rentals and demos.

findings.quote: the Sonnenalp Ski Concierge has partnered with the experts at Gorsuch to provide top of the line rentals and demos for skis, snowboards and helmets

claims.text: Breakfast is served on Ludwig's glass-enclosed terrace overlooking Gore Creek.

findings.quote: Sonnenalp's bountiful European style breakfast is served on the beautiful glass enclosed Ludwig’s terrace overlooking Gore Creek.

claims.text: The Sonnenalp Ski Concierge has a private lounge with secure lockers at Gorsuch Ski Cafe.

findings.quote: boasting a private lounge, secure lockers and personalized service located at Gorsuch Ski Café.

claims.text: Gorsuch Ski Cafe is 50 steps from Gondola One.

findings.quote: Gorsuch Ski Cafe offers top of the line rentals equipment and helmets, along with the latest technology for tuning, repairs and waxing in a private setting just 50 steps from Gondola One.

claims.text: The spa has a heated indoor and outdoor pool with a riverfront sun deck and a summer pool bar.

findings.quote: Heated indoor & outdoor tranquility pool with riverfront sun deck and summer pool bar.

claims.text: Hotel guests have preferred access to tee times at the Sonnenalp Club golf course.

findings.quote: Sonnenalp hotel guests have preferred access to golf tee times.

claims.text: The Sonnenalp Club golf course is in Edwards, 16 miles west of Vail Village, not at the hotel.

findings.quote: The Sonnenalp Club is perfectly located in the sun drenched valley of Edwards, 16 miles west of Vail Village.
